[color=#FFD700]击杀条件：[/color]由 %s 个或以上的史莱: [color=#FFD700]Kill condition:[/color] formed from %s or more Slimes composing a %s Type[color=#FFB74D] (%s, must include self)[/color]
[color=#FFD700][font_size=20]骰型倍率[/font_:
[color=#FFD700][font_size=20]Type Multipliers[/font_size][/color]
[hr color=#777777 height=1 width=100%]
Slime dice within your attack range and pocket dice together form Types.
[color=#42A5F5]At least 2 dice: 2 make Lv.1, each extra die raises the level by 1, 6 or more = Lv.5.[/color]
The system picks the combo with the highest total attack score; one combo may contain multiple Types, and scores add up.
[color=#FFB74D]When a group meets several Types at once, only the highest-scoring Type of that group counts, without stacking.[/color]
Single Type score = sum of the base values of the participating dice × that Type's multiplier.
[color=#AAAAAA]Dice that form no Type score nothing.[/color]
[color=#FFD700][font_size=20]骰型组合[/font_:
[color=#FFD700][font_size=20]Type Combos[/font_size][/color]
[hr color=#777777 height=1 width=100%]
[color=#FFD700]Pair[/color]: at least 2 dice with the same points, any colors. E.g.: Red3+Blue3.
[color=#FFD700]Straight[/color]: at least 2 dice with consecutive points, any colors, [color=#42A5F5]repeated point values count only once toward consecutive points[/color]. E.g.: Red2+Blue2+Yellow3+Green4 (the two 2s count as one; consecutive points 2/3/4).
[color=#FFD700]Flush[/color]: at least 2 dice of the same color, any points. E.g.: Red2+Red5.
[color=#FFD700]Color Pair[/color]: at least 2 dice of the same color and same point. E.g.: Red3+Red3.
[color=#FFD700]Color Straight[/color]: at least 2 dice of the same color with consecutive points, [color=#42A5F5]repeated point values count only once toward consecutive points[/color]. E.g.: Red2+Red2+Red3 (the two 2s count as one; consecutive points 2/3).
[color=#42A5F5]Type level: same rules as Type Multipliers, 2 make Lv.1, each extra die raises the level by 1, 6 or more = Lv.5; Straight/Color Straight count by deduplicated consecutive points.[/color]
[color=#FFB74D]When a group meets several Types at once (e.g. Red3+Red3 is both a Color Pair and a Pair), only the highest-scoring Type of that group counts, without stacking.[/color]
[color=#FFD700][font_size=20]点数分值[/font_:
[color=#FFD700][font_size=20]Point Scores[/font_size][/color]
[hr color=#777777 height=1 width=100%]
Points 1–6 each have an independent base value, randomly assigned at the start of each run.
[color=#42A5F5]Each point's base value falls between 5 and 15, and the six point values total 60.[/color]
Only dice that form a Type contribute their base value to the score.
[color=#FFD700]Single Type score = sum of the base values of the participating dice × that Type's multiplier[/color]
[color=#AAAAAA]Dice that form no Type produce no score.[/color]
[color=#FFD700][font_size=20]骰子口袋[/font_:
[color=#FFD700][font_size=20]Dice Pocket[/font_size][/color]
[hr color=#777777 height=1 width=100%]
The pocket holds up to [color=#FFD700]1 die[/color], which joins the next attack's Type calculation.
It is consumed once used for scoring; if not used for scoring it becomes a drop candidate.
[color=#42A5F5]With only 1 dropped die it is kept automatically; with several, pick 1 and discard the rest.[/color]
[color=#FFB74D]The pocket empties when a stage is cleared.[/color]
[color=#FFD700][font_size=20]分数预告[/font_:
[color=#FFD700][font_size=20]Score Preview[/font_size][/color]
[hr color=#777777 height=1 width=100%]
Previews the Type score of the currently selected attack, [color=#FFD700]including pocket dice[/color].
[color=#42A5F5]Base values or Type multipliers changed by BUFFs are reflected in the preview.[/color]
[color=#FFB74D]Does not include extra score added by BUFFs after attack resolution.[/color]
[color=#FFD700][font_size=20]Buff 栏[/fon:
[color=#FFD700][font_size=20]Buff Bar[/font_size][/color]
[hr color=#777777 height=1 width=100%]
Shows the BUFFs acquired and active this run; hover an icon for details.
[color=#FFD700]After clearing a stage you can enter the shop to buy BUFFs.[/color]
[color=#0fff5b]Some BUFFs activate automatically when their conditions are met.[/color]
[color=#FFD700][font_size=20]Debuff 栏[/f:
[color=#FFD700][font_size=20]Debuff Bar[/font_size][/color]
[hr color=#777777 height=1 width=100%]
Elites or the BOSS may bring one or more DEBUFFs.
[color=#0fff5b]After meeting the Type threshold and killing the Elite or BOSS, the corresponding DEBUFF can be cleared early.[/color]
[color=#FFB74D]DEBUFFs not cleared early are removed together when the stage is cleared.[/color]
[color=#FFD700][font_size=20]额外技能格[/font:
[color=#FFD700][font_size=20]Extra Skill Slots[/font_size][/color]
[hr color=#777777 height=1 width=100%]
Up to [color=#FFD700]3[/color] extra skills (coin skills) can be equipped.
Buying with a full bar requires choosing a replacement.
[color=#42A5F5]Each skill can be used once per stage and recovers when the stage is cleared.[/color]
[color=#FFD700]Q/W/E correspond to the three skill slots.[/color]
[color=#FFD700][font_size=20]血瓶进度[/font_:
[color=#FFD700][font_size=20]Potion Progress[/font_size][/color]
[hr color=#777777 height=1 width=100%]
Accumulates by Type score, [color=#FFB74D]excluding extra score added by BUFFs[/color].
Reaching the threshold grants 1 healing potion; the required score then increases.
[color=#42A5F5]When potions hit the storage cap, use one to free a slot before earning the next.[/color]
[color=#FFD700][font_size=20]经验条[/font_s:
[color=#FFD700][font_size=20]EXP Bar[/font_size][/color]
[hr color=#777777 height=1 width=100%]
Each Slime killed grants [color=#FFD700]1 EXP point[/color].
When EXP is full, choose 1 of three level-up cards.
[color=#0fff5b]Every 5 levels, max HP +1[/color]; [color=#FFB74D]current HP is not restored by this.[/color]
[color=#FFD700][font_size=20]护盾[/font_si:
[color=#FFD700][font_size=20]Shield[/font_size][/color]
[hr color=#777777 height=1 width=100%]
At turn settlement, calculated as [color=#42A5F5]remaining Slimes － Shield[/color].
No damage at 0 or below; above 0, every 3 Slimes deal 1 damage, with remainders counted as 1.
[color=#FFD700]Example: 7 Slimes, 2 Shield → take 2 damage.[/color]
[color=#FFD700][font_size=20]能量[/font_si:
[color=#FFD700][font_size=20]Energy[/font_size][/color]
[hr color=#777777 height=1 width=100%]
Shows current Energy / max Energy.
[color=#0fff5b]Kill the cyan-highlighted Energy Slimes to restore 1 Energy.[/color]
[color=#42A5F5]Empowered skills consume 1 point on a successful cast.[/color]
[color=#FFB74D]Some skills must be empowered first before use.[/color]
[color=#FFD700][font_size=20]英雄技能[/font_:
[color=#FFD700][font_size=20]Hero Skills[/font_size][/color]
[hr color=#777777 height=1 width=100%]
The current hero's 3 signature skills.
[color=#FFD700]Number keys 1/2/3 correspond to the three skills.[/color]
[color=#FFD700][font_size=20]赋能按钮[/font_:
[color=#FFD700][font_size=20]Empower Button[/font_size][/color]
[hr color=#777777 height=1 width=100%]
Click to enter the empower state; click again to cancel.
[color=#FFB74D]Cannot empower without Energy; at most 1 skill empowered at a time.[/color]
A successful cast consumes 1 Energy and resets.
[color=#FFD700]Shortcut: Alt+1/2/3[/color]
[color=#FFD700][font_size=20]结束回合[/font_:
[color=#FFD700][font_size=20]End Turn[/font_size][/color]
[hr color=#777777 height=1 width=100%]
Give up this attack and end the turn, gaining a die of random color and random 1–6 points.
[color=#42A5F5]If the pocket already holds a die, choose one of the two to keep.[/color]
[color=#FFD700]Shortcut: Space[/color]
[color=#FFD700][font_size=20]重置移动[/font_:
[color=#FFD700][font_size=20]Reset Move[/font_size][/color]
[hr color=#777777 height=1 width=100%]
Restores the hero and the Slimes on the field to their pre-move positions and rolls back the score gained from the move.
[color=#FFB74D]You can only undo before attacking.[/color]
[color=#FFD700]Shortcut: R[/color]
[color=#FFD700][font_size=20]使用血瓶[/font_:
[color=#FFD700][font_size=20]Use Potion[/font_size][/color]
[hr color=#777777 height=1 width=100%]
Consume 1 healing potion to restore 1 HP, up to max HP.
[color=#FFB74D]Cannot use with no potions or at full HP.[/color]
[color=#AAAAAA]Some BUFFs can change the amount restored.[/color]
[color=#FFD700]Shortcut: F[/color]
[color=#FFD700][font_size=20]关闭帮助[/font_:
[color=#FFD700][font_size=20]Close Help[/font_size][/color]
[hr color=#777777 height=1 width=100%]
Closes the help screen and returns to the battle.
[color=#FFD700]You can also press H to close.[/color]

击杀周围4格（上下左右）内的史莱姆，使用能量时为周围8格（含四角）: Kills Slimes in the 4 surrounding tiles (up/down/left/right); when Energy is used, all 8 surrounding tiles (corners included).
面前反向凹字5格内的史莱姆被强制向英雄方向移动1格，需消耗1能量: Slimes within the reversed concave 5-tile zone in front are forced 1 tile toward the hero; costs 1 Energy.
